project.name: OPlague
project.summary: Windows-first driver-management workbench for read-only hardware discovery, bounded package inspection, integrity reports, normalized metrics, gaming telemetry and federated device/GPU snapshots.

capabilities.summary: Collects present Windows Plug and Play device records through a fixed, read-only PowerShell query.
Inspects INF metadata and ZIP archive structure with bounded entry, path, size and compression checks; does not extract or execute payloads.
Validates UDRV manifests, payload inventory, declared sizes, hashes and path/resource constraints without installation or execution.
Builds ordered batch inspection summaries with aggregate counts and a deterministic bundle fingerprint.
Compares normalized profiles using weighted distances, cosine similarity, orthogonality and repeated-run variance.
Creates candidate-only edges from exact normalized hardware-ID matches; it does not rank, install or certify drivers.
Exports bounded, versioned JSON snapshots with pseudonymous device fingerprints and explicit read-only mode.
Offers an opt-in native metric cross-check through a trusted Pytyliki ABI v1 library.
Computes bounded boolean powers of the exact-ID device-driver candidate graph while preserving read-only, evidence-only semantics.
Validates the complete three-project directed peer product, eight octagonal pyramid facets and local self-loops without a central runtime dependency.
Exports bounded NVIDIA GPU sensor snapshots with explicit unknown values, read-only source metadata and a canonical SHA-256 payload digest.

A Rust 2021 native consumer checks and calls the caller-owned Pytyliki diagnostics ABI v1 record through an explicit shared-library path; this is a bounded integration component, not a full OPlague Rust/Slint migration.

Read-only standard-library validation and a strict JSON Schema for bounded age-banded early-math activity packs. Rejects unknown/personal-data fields, timers, scoring, network dependencies, external links, embedded executable markup, duplicate keys and oversized inputs; does not execute or render content.

interfaces.format: OCTA-8 octagonal-pyramid topology and peer contract
Read-only validation summary for a Reaper comparison report
Versioned read-only GPU telemetry JSON snapshot
C ABI v1 diagnostics record; 144-byte, 8-byte-aligned, caller-owned buffer

integrations.summary: Exports snapshots that Reaper can import for offline device-profile comparison.
Loads a caller-selected trusted Pytyliki library only when a native cross-check is requested.
Validates caller-selected Reaper read-only comparison reports; it does not execute reports or change devices.
Participates in the direct OCTA-8 peer mesh and exposes the Reaper-report consumer edge.
Participates in the OCTA-8 peer mesh; native request/response remains explicit and caller initiated.
Audio-pack generation is outside OPlague's Windows device and driver-package inspection domain; no device actions are coupled to VentuSample.
Exports a caller-selected read-only GPU sensor snapshot for offline Reaper/DAK ingestion; no control or driver action is performed.
A Rust consumer is under review and pins the exact Pytyliki ABI proposal commit; the integration remains unproven until C11 and Rust checks pass on the pinned SHA.

safety_boundaries: Live device enumeration is read-only and currently Windows-only; portable analysis applies to saved files and reports.
Imported INF, ZIP, UDRV and other package content is treated as untrusted and is never executed by the inspector.
Compatibility output is candidate evidence, not a trust, signing, OS-support or installation verdict.
No driver is installed, removed, enabled, disabled, extracted or modified by the federated inspection workflow.
Raw PnP instance IDs are omitted from snapshots in favor of linkable SHA-256 fingerprints; this is pseudonymization, not anonymization.
GPU telemetry export is NVIDIA nvidia-smi read-only only; unavailable fields remain null, and the SHA-256 digest is integrity metadata rather than a digital signature.
extension_points: Versioned JSON device and inspection-bundle interfaces.
Read-only package inspector adapters with bounded input and archive policies.
Explicit exact-ID matching rules and metric dimensions.
Opt-in native C ABI adapter for trusted Pytyliki builds.
Bounded boolean graph self-product for multi-hop exact-candidate relationship analysis.
